# Elixpo Mails

> Event-based transactional email for the Elixpo ecosystem. Teams connect their own SMTP mailbox, design templates with {{variables}} in a visual editor, and trigger sends with HMAC-signed webhooks. Runs on Cloudflare's edge.

## Integration rules

- Sign every webhook request with the product's HMAC secret; requests without a valid signature are rejected.
- Mail is sent from the tenant's own mailbox; Elixpo Mails is not the sender of record.
- Every send carries a List-Unsubscribe header; suppressed recipients are skipped.
